samples.question: The colored disk marks the token's starting cell in the large 3-by-3 grid. Read the four small command grids from top to bottom. In each command, the bright 2-by-2 block identifies four cells whose contents rotate one corner clockwise: top-left to top-right to bottom-right to bottom-left to top-left. All other cells stay fixed. After all four commands, which cell holds the token: top-left, top, top-right, left, center, right, bottom-left, bottom, or bottom-right?
